summary: Fatal free-solo fall on Gregory Flatironette; body found September 27.
notes: CPR 2015-09-29 corroboration: victim identified as Angus Moloney, 22 (New York, living in Montreal); found dead Sunday morning 2015-09-27 below the formation; AAC notes Gregory Flatironette = Fifth Pinnacle; ~100-ft free-solo fall the day before, per Boulder County sheriff's deputies. Run 880 merge.
